svg.text: Numbering typo (TC) · TC · Temporal_ID: s144A_2_e
Current text
(e)符合以下說明的名銜或描述：可合理地致使任何人相信，使用(或獲准使用)
該名銜或描述的人持有某資格，而該資格 ——(i)
是專為批准該人在香港境內提供專利代理服務而授予該人的；及
(i)是獲法律承認
的，或獲政府認可的。
Counterpart — English
(e) a title or description which may reasonably cause anyone to believe that the person using or
permitted to use the title or description holds a qualification— (i) that is specifically granted for
approving that person to provide patent agency services in Hong Kong; and
(ii) that
is recognized
by law or endorsed by the Government.
Suggested correction
Second subparagraph: “(ii)是獲法律承認的，或獲政府認可的。” The underlying <num value>,
name and Temporal_ID must be corrected at the same time.
